newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER GHEDINA.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF DOWNHILL WINNER GHEDINA.

text.p: Following is a brief profile of the winner of a men's World Cup downhill on Saturday:
World Cup wins: 7. Downhill - Wengen (97), Chamonix (97), Val Gardena (96), Whistler (95), Wengen (95), Are (90), Cortina (90).

Other feats: Downhill silver medallist at the 1996 world championships. Also took silver medal at 1991 world championships in the combined. Badly injured in a car accident in the spring of 1991. Was in coma for three days and many thought would never ski again. Lost part of an ear in the crash when it was cut off by a ski in the car. Says his only hobby is speed and danger. Enjoys moto-cross around the mountains in his home in Cortina.
